parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Good afternoon. Good Time Restaurant.

Hi, is this Michelle?

Yes, speaking.

This is Brian Troy. We spoke last week about planning a party to celebrate my wife’s promotion. Well, I would like to go ahead with it, and I have a list of things that I would like to go through with you.

Yes. I remember we’d spoken about a few dinner options, like a romantic dinner for two or a small group for dinner. Have you decided yet?

Well, I think I would like to surprise my wife with a huge party. In fact, I’ve already started to contact a few of our friends and family, as well as some of the people my wife works with.

Alright, so let’s get the party details confirmed. So how many guests would you like? Are you thinking of over 100?

Nah, I was thinking of more like 50, but then I realized that we have friends living out of town. So let’s say 80 in case everyone wants to come.

Okay. And do you still want October 6th?

 Actually, no, I need to change that. My daughter can’t make it then because she has a piano recital. Would September 26th work for you?

No problem. That date’s still open. Now, do you realize that’s not a Saturday? Are you okay with that?

Yes, I am. When I look at my schedule, Friday is a better choice for all of us.

Great. Now we need to decide on the times. How does 6:00 to 10:00 sound?

That’s fine.

So now let’s talk about the room. I have several options that might work. There’s the Queen Room, the Royal Room, the Palace Room and...

The King Room. Right. I’ve been there before.

Actually, we recently renovated that room and I think that it would be great for your party. You’ll be very happy with it. And shall I book it for you?

Sure, that would be fine.

Have you planned on having music while you’re eating?

I hadn’t thought about it, but it would be nice.

Well, you have some choices. We can arrange for a group to play jazz or one to play the latest pop.

I suspect my kids would prefer to have the pop music, but my wife is a jazz fan, so let’s book that.

Okay, then I’ll book that today. They’re very good, and they might even sing at your table.

Great.

Okay, now we need to talk about the type of service you want for the dinner. We have two options: a self-service buffet or table service.

Let’s go with the latter choice.

And just so you know, the price is the same for either a chicken or a vegetarian plate. One last thing to decide on—are you planning anything special for your wife?

Well, I was thinking that at 8:00 or so, I would like to have a cake brought out.

Very nice. And because you’re making reservations for such a large group, the cake is complementary. What flavor would you like?

Well, it would have to be lemon. I really love chocolate, but it is her day, so let’s go with her favorite.

Good decision. Now, let me tell you about the cakes. We have a square cake, which would easily serve all of your guests, or you could have two cheesecakes. They’re really popular right now.

I prefer the first option because I would like to have something special written on it. But let’s keep it simple. How about “Congratulations”?

Okay, I can have our baker take care of that. He’s happy to show you what it would look like if you wish. Now, is there anything else?

No, I don’t think so. I think we’ve pretty well talked about everything.

So, let’s lock in the reservation details. I’ll need to have a deposit of $50.

Let’s make it for $100 and I’ll put it on my Mastercard. Is that okay?

Sure. What’s the 16-digit account number?

55,44,12, double 0,43,26,888,7. And it expires in November.

Is there another name on the card beside Brian Troy? A middle name or initial?

Yes, Sebastian. I will spell it for you. S, E, B, A, S, T, I, A, N. Is there anything else?

No, I think that’s it. However, you need to be aware of an additional fee for large groups. There is an extra charge that covers service. But I think that’s all for now. We look forward to having your celebration dinner here.

analyses.content: 男士起初想说50人，但考虑到可能有外地朋友，为了保险起见（in case everyone wants to come），最终敲定是 80 人。
Nah, I was thinking of more like 50, but then I realized that we have friends living out of town. So let’s say 80 in case everyone wants to come.
不要听到 100 或 50 就直接填，要听完这一连串数字后最终确认的那个数值。
Actually, no, I need to change that. My daughter can’t make it then because she has a piano recital. Would September 26th work for you? No problem. That date’s still open.
听到 October 6th 要小心，那是被否定的旧计划，紧接着的 "No" 是重要的信号词。
男士说原来的日期不行，因为女儿有钢琴演奏会，于是改成了 September 26th（9月26日）。
There’s the Queen Room, the Royal Room, the Palace Room and... The King Room. Right. I’ve been there before. ... And shall I book it for you? Sure, that would be fine.
不要被 Queen, Royal, Palace 这些干扰项迷惑，它们只是备选名单，不是最终选择。
虽然女士列举了好几个房间，但男士提到 King Room 他去过，并且随后确认预订这个房间。
I suspect my kids would prefer to have the pop music, but my wife is a jazz fan, so let’s book that.
听到 pop music 别急着写，要听到转折词 "but" 后面关于妻子的喜好才是决定性因素。
男士说虽然孩子们喜欢流行乐（pop），但他妻子是 jazz（爵士乐）迷，因为是庆祝妻子的升职，所以听妻子的。
必须听懂 "latter" 代表“后者/第二个”，如果这词不熟，这分就丢了。
We have two options: a self-service buffet or table service. Let’s go with the latter choice.
女士提供了自助餐（buffet）和餐桌服务（table service）两个选项，男士选择了“后者（the latter choice）”，即 table service。
Well, it would have to be lemon. I really love chocolate, but it is her day, so let’s go with her favorite.
不要听到 "love chocolate" 就填上去，注意听后面的 "but it is her day"（但这是她的日子）。
男士虽然自己爱吃巧克力，但为了妻子，决定选她最喜欢的 lemon（柠檬）口味。
I prefer the first option because I would like to have something special written on it. But let’s keep it simple. How about “Congratulations”?
这个词拼写较长，容易拼错（注意是 't' 不是 'd'，且是复数形式），平时要多练。
男士希望蛋糕上写的字简单点，提议写 Congratulations（祝贺）。
Yes, Sebastian. I will spell it for you. S, E, B, A, S, T, I, A, N.
即使觉得自己会拼，也一定要利用录音中的字母拼写（S-E-B...）进行二次核对。
男士报出了中间名 Sebastian，并随后进行了逐个字母的拼写。
However, you need to be aware of an additional fee for large groups. There is an extra charge that covers service.
听到 "extra charge for..." 时要竖起耳朵，答案就在紧随其后的名词里。
女士最后提醒有一个涵盖 service（服务）的额外费用。
